interpretation: A bounded attach to the official unmodified 7.2.5.32 APK observed 19 NetworkParams/r4 callbacks. Eighteen returned all six seven-god headers with the recorded lengths; one separate result contained X-Neptune only. All three Cronet entry hooks and o0 were installed but no Cronet event occurred in this reader window. This is an OkHttp/NetworkParams observation and does not establish Cronet execution, standalone signing, or online acceptance.
